compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Readers approach innumerable angels in festal assembly beside Angels obey the voice of the heavenly king; Angels and the heavenly army praise their creator; The prayer places an angelic army before the throne; The tempter quotes angelic protection and angels serve Jesus. Those passages share its angelic register or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
